body_lead: Maharashtra Govt Approves Rs 4.95 Cr AI Powered Super Portal for Labour and Industry Updated: Aug 05, 2025 05:45:18pm Mumbai, Aug 5 (KNN) The Maharashtra government is making a major digital leap by developing an AI-powered “super portal” for its Labour and Industry departments. The portal, expected to be launched by September 2025, aims to simplify services, reduce paperwork, and enhance user experience for businesses and workers alike. The state cabinet has approved a budget of Rs 4.95 crore for the project.
